fields.name: sourceurl
fields.doc: Canonical URI of the source text object, filling `sourceurl` (65026).

fields.name: rownum
fields.doc: 1-based physical line number within the source object.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: UTC instant captured from the line header, at microsecond resolution. Capture context, and only that: it is the clock the bridge stamped the *line* with, so it dates no message on its own. What dates a message is stated by the FIX seam, which offers this instant as the `SendingTime` a message carrying none of its own takes.

fields.name: timepartition
fields.doc: Timestamp partitioned by its UTC hour in Iceberg.

fields.name: threadId
fields.doc: Bridge thread identifier captured from the line header.

fields.name: bridgesessionid
fields.doc: Bridge session instance the line was handled on, filling 65032. The session *instance*, which is the bracket's own first part -- never `sendersessionid` (65007), which is what a bridge row spells for the counterparty session the message names. Two connections to one counterparty are two instances, so they are two facts.

fields.name: msgseqnum
fields.doc: Bridge sequence number, filling `MsgSeqNum` (34) where a frame stated none.

fields.name: pluginid
fields.doc: Bridge plugin that wrote the line, filling `pluginid` (65009).

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Severity spelling captured from the line header.

fields.name: bodyhash
fields.doc: XXH3-128 digest of the exact body bytes, filled during field apply.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: Exact bytes after the matched line-header prefix.
